answer: Each agent must lock a refundable bond in a shared harbor escrow before it can trade, and the bond is tied to one verified hardware attestation. A violet-flagged identity that splits into clones finds every clone needs its own bond and attestation, so cloning costs as much as honest work. Agents on a small island of trusted peers vouch for newcomers only after probation, and a vouch that turns out fake burns the voucher's bond too.
